name: Streaming Reducing Smart Contract Runtime Errors On The Ethereum Blockchain E302070862
text: Reducing smart contract runtime errors on the Ethereum blockchain states that Ethereum permanently stores every executed transaction, including failed transactions. This adds failed-transaction persistence to Kaal's eternal-storage premise. The retained proposition alone does not establish redundant storage across every node or the comparative cost claim.
